customer_reply:
Hi,

Thank you for contacting Zycus Support. To delegate your approvals while you are out of office, please follow these steps:

1. Open your profile menu and select Out of Office.
2. Choose a delegate with the same or higher approval limit.
3. Set the start and end dates (delegation ends automatically on the end date).
4. Optional: Tick "Notify delegate" to send an email notification to your delegate.

Note that delegation applies to requisitions, purchase orders, and invoices routed to you during the selected dates. If you have documents already pending before the start date, you can reassign them manually from Workflow > Pending.

Please let us know if you need any further assistance!

Best regards,
Zycus Support Team
